status: Independent NVLink confirmation complete; directional performance is workload dependent. GIN performance and full serving comparison pending.
scope: Communication only; no expert GEMMs or serving throughput. Initialization, JIT and graph capture excluded; graph replay included. One captured graph per token extent, not one maximum-capacity graph.
metric: Each block uses the maximum Attention-rank CUDA-event latency per exchange. Each process uses the median of five blocks. Change is median of three paired process ratios minus one; positive means slower. Masked132 is a fixed control, not a claim that132 is optimal for every shape. Tuned controls and independent routes remain to be confirmed.

registered_capacity.definition: Logical registered transport-buffer capacity summed across four ranks; excludes other allocations and is not total VRAM.

correctness.scope: NVLink H2048/H4096 BF16/FP8, eager/graphs, changing live counts and routes, empty/skewed/asymmetric storage, poisoned/reused slots, delayed peers, mixed collectors and numerical edge cases
correctness.status: passed; GIN additionally covers eight H100s, BF16/FP8 hybrid/direct, capacities128/2048, changing-count graphs and delayed/poisoned reuse

interpretation: Source packing/count kernel median fell from90.08us to57.78us after grid132to528; all CUDA SASS is byte-identical to parent e376.
Request/grouping is63.01us slower, return64.46us faster and source completion6.79us slower than Masked132 in fresh phase medians.
Masked dispatch overlaps its copy epilogue. Durations include waits/overlap and do not isolate network, counting or achieved hardware bandwidth.
nsight.figure: Representative exchanges closest to each trace median, not a stack of independent kernel medians. Profiled diagnostics are separate from unprofiled timing.

independent_nvlink.hardware: 4 H100 80GB, Hopper SM90, one NVLink domain,2Attention+2FFN
independent_nvlink.execution: graph per token extent; runtime replay included; initialization/JIT/capture/GEMMs excluded
independent_nvlink.method: Three fresh balanced process pairs per arm; process median of five blocks of1000 exchanges after1000 warmups. Each block uses maximum Attention-rank CUDA-event latency. Structured routes are deterministic; only random routes change with seed.
independent_nvlink.summary_method: Equal-cell geometric mean of each cell's median paired process ratio; descriptive, not serving-workload weighted or a confidence bound. No comparator selected on validation data.
independent_nvlink.cell_arm_arrays: 15 block latencies in microseconds per arm: five blocks for repeat0, then five for repeat1, then five for repeat2. Process latency is the median of its five blocks.
independent_nvlink.resource_note: DeepEP num_sms controls transport; local epilogues use the fullGPU. Directional132 is a base launch grid, not an equal hardware resource cap.
independent_nvlink.memory_note: Logical registered communication capacity summed across four ranks; excludes expert/receive tensors, caller allocations and total VRAM.
